characters.name: Michael
characters.description: Young adult man; short black hair, brown eyes, lean build; scar above right eyebrow.

characters.name: Sarah
characters.description: Young adult woman; long brown hair, green eyes.

chapters.name: Chapter 1
chapters.sourceText:
Chapter 1
Michael and Sarah waited on the railway platform. Michael had short black hair, brown eyes, and a scar above his right eyebrow. He wore a black jacket and a silver watch on his left wrist. Sarah had long brown hair, green eyes, and a red coat.
The station guard pointed toward the exit. An unnamed man in a gray coat walked past them.
Sarah handed Michael a brass key. Michael put the key in his right hand. “Keep it safe,” Sarah said.
A loose wooden crate slid toward Sarah. Michael pulled her out of its path and scraped his right cheek on the crate.
They quietly sat on a bench and watched the train leave.

chapters.name: Chapter 2
chapters.sourceText:
Chapter Two
At the school entrance the following morning, Michael still carried the brass key in his right hand. The scrape on his right cheek remained visible. He changed from his black jacket into a blue school uniform, keeping his silver watch on his left wrist.
Sarah tied her long brown hair into a ponytail and removed her red coat, revealing a white sweater. “The guard told us to come here,” she said.
A teacher with gray hair opened the classroom door. Michael and Sarah entered the classroom together.
Michael placed the brass key on the teacher’s desk. Sarah stood beside him. They waited quietly for the teacher to speak.
